title: Using your abilities
description: Not feeling like you could do the job with one hand tied behind your back. Stretching yourself. Using your skills.

title: Accomplishment
description: Feeling that you achieve something. You have clear goals. You can see the result of your efforts.

title: Being busy
description: Not having stretches of time when you have nothing to do. You have a buzz of activity.

title: Being responsible
description: Taking charge of your own work and the work of others. Being accountable.

title: Variety of task
description: Every day is not the same because you do different things.

title: Variety of environment
description: Every day is not the same because you are in different places.

title: Variety of contact
description: Every day is not the same because you are interacting with different people.

title: Adventure
description: You regularly take risks and have feelings of exhilaration or danger.

title: Fun
description: You are able to be light-hearted. You don’t have to be serious all the time.

title: Prestige environment
description: The place where you work is held in high regard as a major player in the field.

title: Advancement
description: There are opportunities to be promoted to higher positions.

title: Money
description: You earn or have the potential to earn a larger than average salary. You have perks, such as a company car, etc.

title: Development
description: There are opportunities to enhance, expand, or develop your role and learn new things.

title: Recognition
description: When you perform well, your efforts are acknowledged or rewarded by praise, promotion, or money.

title: Authority
description: You get to tell people what to do. You give direction to others.

title: Social status
description: You feel proud when you tell people what you do for a living. People think your job is interesting or glamorous.

title: Colleagues
description: The people you work with are easy to get on with or interesting. There are opportunities for socialising with colleagues.

title: Helping individuals
description: You are involved in providing aid and assistance to people directly.

title: Helping society
description: You are doing something which contributes beneficially to society.

title: Caring
description: You are involved in showing support, empathy and love to others.

title: Nurturing
description: You are involved in helping other people develop.

title: Justifiable
description: What you are doing fits in with your moral value system.

title: Fairness
description: You and other workers are treated fairly by your employer. You have good conditions of employment.

title: Spirituality
description: Your work allows you to express or explore your faith.

title: Management
description: You have a good working relationship with your boss. Your manager's way of working fits well with your own.

title: Training
description: Structured opportunities for learning are provided and supported.

title: Creativity
description: You get to generate new ideas or solutions to problems. You get to innovate and be original.

title: Decision making
description: You get to make some of the choices that affect your work.

title: Autonomy
description: You have some freedom to do things when you want and how you want.

title: Being expert
description: You have the opportunity to gain and use an in-depth knowledge of a subject. You are seeking advice in this area.

title: Competition
description: You get the opportunity to test your abilities against others.

title: Subject
description: Your work is enjoyable because you have a strong interest in the subject matter you are dealing with.

title: Aesthetics
description: You deal with ideas or things that are beautiful and require appreciation.

title: Quality
description: You work in situations in which precision and attention to detail are important, or where there is little room for error.

title: Security
description: You have security of employment. It is not likely that you will lose your job or find another job regularly.

title: Stress-free
description: You do not have to work under high levels of stress. The pressure of work is not too high and there is little conflict.

title: Health
description: Your work positively contributes to your physical and psychological wellbeing.

title: Stability
description: Work routines and duties are largely predictable and not likely to be subject to sudden or unforeseen changes.

title: Hours
description: You do not work more than average or irregular hours. Your job does not impinge on your family or social life. The patterns of work suit your lifestyle.

title: Resources
description: You have the materials, equipment, and money you need to do the job. You are not expected to produce great results without the right tools.

title: Workspace
description: The place where you work is comfortable and suited to your working style and personal preferences.

title: Supportive
description: The organisation you work for is open and tolerant. Your views are sought and respected during decision making.

title: Cooperation
description: Your work requires operating as part of a team and interacting with others to achieve a goal.
